title: Gross Rent
text: .  Monthly Rent includes Tenant’s Proportionate Share of Taxes, of the premiums for the insurance Landlord is required to carry under this Lease, and of Operating Costs.  Except as provided in subsection (c) of this Section and elsewhere in this Lease with respect to costs caused by or separately attributable to Tenant, Tenant shall not be required to pay any additional rent on account of Taxes, insurance premiums or Operating Costs, and there shall be no base-year or expense-stop pass-through, and no annual estimate or reconciliation of Operating Costs, under this Lease.

old: If the Building is not fully occupied, for purposes of calculating Tenant's Proportionate Share, Landlord may "gross up" Operating Costs to what they would have been if the Building or Project had been fully occupied.
new: Operating Costs shall not include any cost that is separately billed to, or paid directly by, Tenant or any other tenant of the Project.

title: Exclusions
text: .  Notwithstanding subsection (a) of this Section, Tenant shall pay, as additional rent within fifteen (15) days after invoice: (i) all taxes and assessments levied on Tenant’s personal property, trade fixtures, inventory and Alterations, and any sales, use, rent or excise tax imposed on Tenant or on the rent payable by Tenant (other than Landlord’s income taxes); (ii) any increase in the premium for insurance carried by Landlord to the extent caused by Tenant’s particular use or occupancy of the Demised Premises or by Tenant’s failure to comply with this Lease; (iii) all utilities and services furnished to or consumed in the Demised Premises as provided in the section of this Lease entitled “SERVICES AND UTILITIES”; (iv) the cost of any repair, maintenance or service that this Lease allocates to Tenant or that is necessitated by the act or omission of Tenant or its agents, employees, contractors, invitees or vehicles; and (v) any charge under the section of this Lease entitled “PARKING.”  Nothing in this Section limits Landlord’s right to recover such amounts, and such amounts are not Operating Costs for purposes of subsection (a) of this Section.
